title: Qingyao's Bloodline
next_chapter_hook: Just as the blood resonance between the two intensified, the Tianji Record and the Qingyao Sword simultaneously resonated, and the fourth possibility began to take shape—a fork in the road that had never appeared in any prophecy.

text.content: The night was as dark as ink, yet deep within the Imperial Capital's Heavenly Secrets Pavilion, lanterns blazed brightly. The demonic path mist in Ye Qing's hands writhed like a living creature. The eerie purple fog twisted and contracted, ultimately pointing toward the most secret library in the pavilion. Chen Ji's gaze darkened—the direction led exactly where the Tianqing Sect's successive sect masters' forbidden grounds lay.

"Chen Ji, do you feel it?" Su Qingyao stood beside Chen Ji, a faint cyan light flickering at her brow center—a sign of the great formation's warning. The Qingyao Sword in her hand hummed softly, as if sensing some ancient call. "It's more than a feeling." Chen Ji murmured, his fingertip tracing the edge of the Tianji Record Fragment, "The Tianji Record just pulsed—and the last time I felt this was when you first began to doubt me."

dialogue.content: "You're someone who keeps everything locked in your heart." Su Qingyao glanced at him, her tone carrying a hint of resignation, "The source of the rumors originates from within the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion... Master Ancestor Ling Yuan's domain. What do you plan to do?"

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer. His gaze pierced through the numerous courtyards, landing on the library wrapped in layers of prohibitions. The runes on the Tianji Record Fragment began to move on their own, and a subtle pulling force emanated from deep within the pavilion. At that moment—A low rumble rose from the ground, and the entire Heavenly Secrets Pavilion trembled slightly. The cyan light at Su Qingyao's brow center burst into brilliant radiance. She clutched her chest and stumbled backward.

dialogue.content: "Qingyao!" Chen Ji's hand shot out, gripping her arm. The temperature of her skin was abnormally scorching. His brow furrowed, "What's happening?"

"I don't know... something is calling me..." Su Qingyao's voice trembled, her usually cold eyes now glazed with a film of tears. Her right hand rose involuntarily, pointing toward the library, "It's calling me back..."

text.content: Go back? Chen Ji's heart lurched. Su Qingyao had grown up in the Tianqing Sect from childhood—when had she ever had a place to "go back" to? Unless—the place referred to was not a physical location at all, but rather a root deep within bloodline memory. The Tianji Record Fragment suddenly blazed with heat, and a line of golden characters appeared: 'Blood Resonance, Seal Loosening.'

Without a word, Chen Ji seized Su Qingyao's wrist and rushed toward the library. Ye Qing followed closely behind, the demonic path mist spreading silently to conceal their movements. Passing through three layers of prohibition and evading two waves of patrolling disciples, they finally arrived at the library's core area. This place was constantly shrouded in formations—even the sect master needed blood verification to enter. Yet now, the formation had been opened wide.

dialogue.content: "Someone got here before us." Ye Qing's voice drifted from the shadows, carrying a weight of gravity, "Moreover... this formation wasn't forcibly broken. It was opened from within. Something inside has awakened on its own."

text.content: Chen Ji tightly clasped Su Qingyao's hand as the two stepped into the pavilion together. Dim lanterns flickered on one by one, illuminating rows of ancient, weathered bookshelves. And in the deepest part, a sword of pure cyan radiance floated in mid-air, its blade flowing with patterns identical to the light at Su Qingyao's brow center. The Qingyao Sword. That ancestral sword passed down through the Su family for generations, never to be touched by outsiders, was now autonomously emanating the aura of its true master.

"The Qingyao Sword..." Su Qingyao murmured, her eyes suddenly reddening. She had known since childhood that this sword was the Su family's supreme treasure, yet she had never imagined it would display such an uncanny phenomenon at this moment. The patterns on the blade resonated with a dormant mark deep within her bloodline—a sense of familiarity originating from the depths of her soul, as if she had finally found her place of belonging.

choice.prompt: The Qingyao Sword undergoes a strange transformation, and Su Qingyao is about to touch upon the secrets deep within her bloodline. How should Chen Ji respond to this sudden upheaval?

choices.description: The Qingyao Sword's transformation is too蹊跷 (bizarre). First take control of the situation to avoid uncontrollable risks.

dialogue.content: "Don't move!" Chen Ji yanked Su Qingyao's arm, pulling her behind him. His fingers pressed against the edge of the Qingyao Sword's pulling force, preventing her from approaching further, "The Tianji Record hasn't finished analyzing this thing's origins. Touching it carelessly is far too dangerous."
"Chen Ji, I..." Su Qingyao turned to look at him, a complex emotion flickering in her eyes, "I know you're doing this for my sake. But this feeling... I must confirm it myself."

text.content: At that moment, the Qingyao Sword violently quivered. A blade aura of biting sharpness pierced through Chen Ji's defenses, shooting directly into Su Qingyao's brow center. In an instant, her eyes became vacant, as if her soul had been dragged into another world.

choices.text: Let her approach and guard her side
choices.description: The bloodline call cannot be resisted. Rather than forcibly preventing it, better to guard her side and face it together.

dialogue.content: "Let's go together." Chen Ji released her arm, instead gripping her wrist, their fingers intertwined. "Something within you is awakening. I'm right here. No matter what you see, I'll be here."

text.content: Su Qingyao was slightly stunned, then gently nodded. She let Chen Ji lead her by the hand, walking step by step toward the suspended Qingyao Sword. Their body temperatures merged at their fingertips, an odd warmth surging from the point of contact, as if some ancient covenant was being reawakened.

The moment Su Qingyao's fingers touched the sword's hilt, both the Tianji Record and the Qingyao Sword erupted with dazzling light. Two beams of light shot skyward, intertwining mid-air to form a massive formation—this was the ancient formation used ten thousand years ago to seal the dimensional rift.

choices.memory_label: 守护选择触发了血脉完整觉醒

text.content:
Countless images flooded into Su Qingyao's consciousness like a tide.

That was a world of primordial chaos, the heavens shattered, spiritual veins severed, countless rifts tearing savage gashes through the void. And on the other side of those rifts, countless twisted black shadows were desperately trying to surge into this world.

She saw a woman dressed in plain white robes, holding a half-formed green sword embryo, standing shoulder to shoulder with a man cloaked in a stellar map. The man's eyes rippled with the trajectories of heavenly secrets, a yellowed bamboo scroll clutched in his hands—the original form of the Tianji Record.

The first Observer.

And that white-robed woman... bore an exact resemblance to her.

dialogue.content: "I am..." Su Qingyao's voice trembled, tears uncontrollably sliding down her cheeks. "I am her descendant... The fate writer who fell ten thousand years ago when sealing the rift... She is my ancestor..."

text.content:
The memories continued to flow.

She witnessed her ancestor using her own bloodline as the catalyst to forge the Qingyao Sword into a sword of fate; saw her making a blood oath with the first Observer to jointly守护 this world; witnessed her being counterattacked by the dimensional rift the moment the sealing was complete, her soul scattered to the winds.

Only a single drop of heart blood remained,融入 the Su family bloodline, passing down through generations.

"So that's how it is..." Chen Ji's voice sounded beside Su Qingyao's ear, low and steadfast. He had never released her hand, allowing the current of blood resonance warmth to flow between the two.

"No wonder the Tianji Record is especially敏锐 to you, no wonder you could detect my abnormality at the first moment." He spoke softly. "You are no ordinary Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, you are a blood descendant of the fate writer—you are our bloodline's... fellow traveler."

choice.prompt: The bloodline truth revealed, Su Qingyao faces a fateful choice. How should she decide?

choices.description: Since the bloodline has awakened, she must take on the ancestor's mission and face the coming dimensional decisive battle together with Chen Ji
choices.visible_cost: Lose the peaceful life of an ordinary disciple

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji." Su Qingyao slowly turned around, gazing directly into his eyes. In those eyes, tear tracks remained, yet burned with unprecedented determination. "My ancestor sacrificed her life to守护 this world. As her descendant, I will never stand by and do nothing."

She gripped Chen Ji's hand in return, their ten fingers tightly intertwined. "The Tianji Record and the Qingyao Sword were always a pair. Since fate brought us together, let this bloodline's power carve a path for you."

text.content: As her words fell, the Qingyao Sword erupted with a thunderous sword cry. The green patterns on the blade spread like living things, slowly coiling around Su Qingyao's arm, merging with her bloodline. At the same time, the fragment of the Tianji Record in Chen Ji's hand trembled violently, golden runes and green sword light reflecting each other.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji, you should go." Su Qingyao slowly drew back her hand, her voice calm to the point of coldness. "This is the responsibility in my bloodline, it has nothing to do with you. You have the Tianji Record to守护, more important missions to fulfill."

"Su Qingyao." Chen Ji's voice suddenly dropped, as he yanked her hand back with a force that almost caused her pain. "Did you forget? I am Chen Ji, the one who leaves nothing to chance? If I didn't want to be involved, I would have walked away long ago."

text.content: He stepped closer, almost face to face with her. "The bond between us isn't because of bloodline, nor fate—it's because I want to protect you. Don't push me away."

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji, I have a proposal." Su Qingyao took a deep breath, the confusion in her eyes gradually replaced by clarity. "In my ancestor's memories, there was a possibility mentioned—the Sword of Fate and the Tianji Record are not simply tools, but the left and right arms of a Fate Weaver."

text.content: She gently touched the sword blade, and the Qingyao Sword obediently hummed in her palm. "The ancestor and the first Observer could fight side by side, without requiring one to protect the other. Perhaps... we can become true companions."

At this moment, a new line of golden characters appeared on the Tianji Record Fragment: 'Blood Resonance holders can share Heavenly Fate consumption.' This was the guidance Mo Xiansheng left behind—the true source of the shared fate buff was actually the bloodline inheritance of the Fate Scribe.

choices.memory_label: 寻找平衡触发了共命机制觉醒

text.content:
The light of the Tianji Record and Qingyao Sword flowed between the two, drawing an ethereal bridge of resonance. Chen Ji felt a warm force pour into his body from his palm—that was the Heavenly Fate power contained within Su Qingyao's bloodline—pure, ancient, carrying the warmth of the Fate Scribe from ten thousand years ago.

Su Qingyao also felt the mystery of the Tianji Record slowly integrating into her consciousness through that resonance bridge. It was a perception ability that transcended the laws of the Three Realms—the unique tacit understanding between Observer and Scribe.

"So that's how it is." Chen Ji murmured, a flash of understanding in his eyes. "The Tianji Record can foresee three hours ahead, the Qingyao Sword can sever the chains of fate. Observer and Scribe were always a pair—you're responsible for recording, I'm responsible for rewriting."

dialogue.content: "So all your arrangements this time..." Su Qingyao stared at him in bewilderment. "You showed me those prophetic visions, all to guide me to awaken?"

"Not entirely." Chen Ji shook his head, a faint smile curling his lips. "Initially, I was just curious why you could repeatedly detect my anomalies. But later I discovered that every time you approached the truth, you were helping me avoid lethal traps."

text.content:
He raised his other hand, gently brushing away the tear stains on her cheek, the gesture so gentle it was unlike his usual demeanor.

"You're the investigator, I'm the chess player. Every step you take closer, I have to become more cautious. It was precisely this game that allowed me to perfect my chess game again and again." Chen Ji's voice was low and sincere. "So, you were helping me."

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao's eyes reddened again, but not from grief. She gently held the hand that lingered beside her cheek and softly said: "Chen Ji, no matter what comes next, I will never stand against you again."

text.content:
Just then, a cold, sinister laugh echoed from deep within the library. That laughter came from the Nine Nether Abyss, carrying an oppressive sensation that stole one's breath.

"Unexpected, truly unexpected. Thetrash杂役 disciple and the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow of Tianqing Sect actually staged such a touching scene right under my nose."

Ling Yuan's figure slowly emerged from the shadows, those murky old eyes flickering with dangerous light.

dialogue.content: "This old man has been waiting for quite some time." Ling Yuan stood with hands behind his back, his tone carrying a hint of playfulness. "The bloodline of a Fate Scribe... now that's a more tempting bargaining chip than the Tianji Record. Brat, do you think your meager cultivation can protect her?"

text.content:
Chen Ji's gaze slightly darkened, yet he showed no panic. He positioned himself in front of Su Qingyao, the Tianji Record Fragment slowly unfurling in his palm as golden runes circulated endlessly.

"Senior Ancestor Ling Yuan, you've truly gone to great lengths." His voice was terrifyingly calm. "Spreading rumors to lure us here, deliberately loosening the seals so we could discover the Qingyao Sword—you just wanted to witness the bloodline awakening with your own eyes, didn't you?"

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan paused briefly, then burst into laughter: "Excellent! Excellent! What a clevertrash! This old man underestimated you. However—" His aura suddenly surged, pressing down until the air itself seemed to freeze. "Do you think with your current strength, you can stop this old man?"

text.content:
Chen Ji didn't answer, merely gently squeezed Su Qingyao's palm.

In the next instant, the Qingyao Sword erupted with a shocking sword intent. That blade of light tore through the darkness like the parting of heaven and earth, slashing directly toward Ling Yuan's face. Contained within that sword intent was the final will left by the Fate Scribe ten thousand years ago—a power that even the Heavenly Dao wouldawe.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji!" Su Qingyao gripped the sword hilt tightly, her eyes filled with determination. "Today, I shall wield my ancestor's sword! Together, we will complete the sealing of the dimensional rift—I, Su Qingyao, will never disgrace the bloodline of the Fate Scribe!"

text.content:
Ling Yuan clutched his arm burned by the sword intent, his expressiongloomy得能滴出水来. He never expected that a Core Formation stage disciple plus a girl who had just awakened could actually injure him.

"Excellent! Excellent! Excellent!" He repeated three times, the killing intent in his eyes almost solidifying. "Today, this old man will let you know what true disparity in strength means!"

Before the words even faded, a vast, sea-like aura erupted from within him—that was the pressure of Nascent Soul stage!

At this critical moment, Ye Qing's Demonic Path mist suddenly rushed in from all directions, shrouding the entire library in darkness so thick that one couldn't see their own hand.

"Go!" Ye Qing's voice rang out in the darkness. "The resonance of the dimensional rift will reach its peak in the time it takes to burn a stick of incense. Miss this opportunity, and who knows when the next one will come!"

Chen Ji didn't hesitate, grabbing Su Qingyao's wrist and darting outward following Ye Qing's guidance. Behind them, Ling Yuan's furious roar made even the mist tremble, yet it couldn't penetrate the barrier woven by the Demonic Path Saint herself.

The moment they burst out of the library, the sky above the Imperial Capital was already shrouded by a massive fissure. The气息 emanating from that fissure was cold and twisted—the unique characteristic of a dimensional rift.

dialogue.content: Qingyao." Chen Ji stopped in his tracks and turned to look at her. "Are you certain you want to come with me? Even I... don't have full confidence of walking out of there alive.

Su Qingyao raised the Qingyao Sword. The azure patterns on the blade intertwined with the mark between her brows, creating a radiant echo. A faint smile graced her features, carrying a composure she had never displayed before.

"The Ancestor gave her life to protect this world, and as her descendant, I will never stand by idly." She spoke these words again, her tone even more resolute than before. "Moreover... I just saw a phrase in my Bloodline Memories."

She reached out to gently touch the blade. The Qingyao Sword resonated obediently in her palm. "The Ancestor fought shoulder to shoulder with the Observer, composing a legend from ten thousand years ago. Today, let this sword carve a path forward for you."

text.content:
Chen Ji stared at her, his throat bobbing subtly.

This woman who had pursued him as an investigator was now willing to stand at his side and face death. The bloodline of the Fate Writer, the inheritance from ten thousand years ago, the impending dimensional battle—all threads of causality interweaving at this very moment.

He let out a soft sigh, a helpless yet warm smile curling at the corner of his lips.

dialogue.content: "Su Qingyao, do you realize how unfair that statement is?" he murmured, reaching out to gently brush her hair, the affectionate gesture unlike his usual demeanor. "Since you insist on coming with me, then... let's go together."

text.content:
As the words fell, the Tianji Record and Qingyao Sword erupted with dazzling brilliance simultaneously. Two pillars of light shot into the heavens, intertwining in mid-air to form a massive formation—the ancient ritual array used ten thousand years ago to seal the rift.

At the center of the formation, a fork in the path that had never appeared in any prophecy was slowly emerging.

The fourth possibility.
